title: Love Will Keep Us Together
description: Best friends begin to have doubts about their fiancés.

title: Snitch
description: To save his teenage son from an unjust prison sentence, a businessman (Dwayne Johnson) makes a deal with a U.S. attorney (Susan Sarandon) to infiltrate a dangerous drug cartel and become an informant.

title: The Wash
description: Two roommates (Dr. Dre, Snoop "Doggy" Dogg) who work at a car wash must save their kidnapped boss (George Wallace) in order to keep their jobs.

title: Lottery Ticket
description: After winning $370 million, a young man (Bow Wow) must survive a holiday weekend with greedy neighbors before he can claim the prize.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S04 E18 — Laid to Waste
A young blind woman reports hearing what she thinks is a murder, but Gillespie and Tibbs cannot find a body.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S04 E19 — First Deadly Sin
A man prohibits his son from contacting the police after the boy witnesses a rape, fearing it will affect his future.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S04 E20 — Just a Country Boy
Bubba and an insurance investigator (Debra Sandlund) search Los Angeles for a bail jumper from Sparta.

title: Rize

description: A greedy heir (Anthony Geary) hires three inept, rap-singing orderlies (The Fat Boys) to care for his rich uncle (Ralph Bellamy).

description: Willie (Doug E. Doug), Tom (Mario Joyner), Johnny (John Leguizamo) and Vinny are fast-talkers from the South Bronx looking for a party.

title: The Marva Collins Story
description: A disillusioned teacher rejects traditional education and opens her own school for ghetto students labeled unteachable.

title: Rock and Roll Revue
description: Vintage clips of great jazz artists.

title: Betty: They Say I'm Different
description: Betty Davis arrives on the '70s scene to break boundaries for women with her daring personality and outrageous funk music. She then, despite being banned and boycotted, goes on to become the first black woman to perform, write and manage herself.

title: Wanda at Large
description:
S02 E09 — Did Wanda Say a 4-Letter Word?
Keith challenges Wanda to see his therapist (Cheryl Hines); Keith regrets his decision when Wanda suddenly admits her attraction to Bradley.

title: Wanda at Large
description:
S02 E13 — Plane Trip
Discontented with the cost of flights, Wanda comes up with an unusual way of traveling abroad; her relationship takes a turn for the unexpected after she discovers that her date is an aerophobic.

title: All About the Andersons
description:
S01 E16 — Face the Music
Anthony takes clarinet lessons with Tuga's piano teacher (Jenny McCarthy), then agrees to perform at a recital where the musicians are younger than he expected.

title: Kevin Hart: What the Fit
description:
S01 E06 — As Seen On TV Fitness With Bill Hader
Kevin Hart orders various fitness equipment from As Seen On TV and invites Bill Hader to try out the equipment.

title: Kevin Hart: What the Fit
description:
S01 E07 — Strongman Competition With Rhett & Link
Kevin Hart meets YouTube stars Rhett & Link at Hart's star on Hollywood Blvd; the trio then join a Strongman Competition.

title: Deceitful
description: Robert (Terry Savage) and Julian (Sal Vance) plan on selling their family's multimillion-dollar business without telling their partner, Isaac (Fredro Starr). As the backstabbing and lies mount, the three fight for money and love.

title: Married to a Baller
description: A woman is married to a pro football player who suffers a career-ending injury. Attracted to money and fame, she leaves him for another man.

title: Do You Know Where Your Man Is
description: A successful, womanizing lawyer marries the woman of his dreams, who knows nothing of his "extracurricular" activities.

title: Pastor Jones: Sisters in Spirit
description: Two sisters (Dinora Walcott, Christina Johnson) compete to win the affection of a handsome young cleric (Jean-Claude La Marre).

title: Pastor Jones: My Sister Loves You
description: A distraught woman seeks guidance from a cleric (Jean-Claude La Marre).

title: Pastor Jones: Heavenly Voices

title: Pastor Jones: Sisters in Spirit 2
description: Pastor Jones (Jean-Claude La Marre) discovers that his late mentor and spiritual adviser was his biological father, and that the two women who have been courting him are his half-sisters.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S04 E21 — No Other Road
Lonnie Jamison and Virgil show a despondent Eugene DeLong, whose father is facing the death penalty for murder, that life continues.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S04 E22 — A Turning
Gillespie and Tibbs track the killers of two drug dealers; Althea worries about the dangers Virgil faces and suggests he change careers.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S05 E01 — A Woman Much Admired
While investigating the death of the woman he once loved, Gillespie meets his daughter for the first time.

title: King of New York
description: A crime lord plots to take control of New York's underground drug economy and distribute the profits to the poor.

title: The Last Boy Scout
description: An ex-Secret Service agent (Bruce Willis) plays private eye with an ex-quarterback (Damon Wayans) on a case of sports gambling and murder.

title: Malibooty
description: Three buddies (Brian Hooks, Sticky Fingaz, J.T. Jackson) leave their Arizona town and head to California for a wild beach party.

title: The Luau
description: A man who owes a large sum of cash throws a party that soon spirals out of control just to raise some money.

title: Da' Booty Shop
description: An exotic dancer (Trina McGee) puts her jailed brother's beauty salon up for sale, then angers the buyer when she decides she'd rather style hair than strip.

title: Jazz Session at the Blue Note With Chaka Khan
description: Recorded in 1993 at the Blue Note Jazz Club in New York City, this performance by Chaka Khan features a number of songs closely associated with jazz.

title: Wanda at Large
description:
S02 E11 — The Unnatural
During another lonely Saturday night, Wanda, Keith and Jenny vow to go on dates with people without trying to pursue meaningful relationships; whoever cannot resist a second date must pay the others; unfortunately, all three meet great partners.

title: Wanda at Large
description:
S02 E10 — Twas the Knife Before Christmas
Wanda desperately wants to go to a fancy Christmas Eve party with Keith, but when Jenny is hospitalized with appendicitis, Wanda must take care of the kids; Still wanting to attend the bash, Wanda hurriedly gets her apartment ready for the holiday.

title: C-Bear and Jamal
description:
Teeing Off
Unable to make it in any other school sports team, Jamal tries out for the golf team, coached along by C-Bear and by Big Chill, who is something of a golf prodigy.

title: C-Bear and Jamal
description: Jamal becomes embarrassed about being middle class when he meets a rich cousin and begins to act more upper crust.

title: C-Bear and Jamal
description:
Raging Bully
When Jamal is teased by a school yard bully, he tries everything from avoidance to a near physical confrontation.

title: C-Bear and Jamal
description:
Hangin' With Mr. Wingo
Jamal learns the best way to be himself after unsuccessfully attempting to ask a girl to the Spring dance.

title: All About the Andersons
description:
S01 E01 — Pilot
A struggling actor (Anthony Anderson) moves in with his parents to provide a stable environment for his son.

title: All About the Andersons
description:

Preparing for his first date in 10 years, Anthony turns to his parents for advice on how to gently tell Tuga the truth.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:

When Chief Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) is kidnapped, Virgil (Howard Rollins) suspects Capt. Dugan (Joe Don Baker) has inside information.

description:

Althea is raped by an acquaintance, and Tibbs is faced with the possibility that they do not have enough evidence to prosecute the man.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S03 E02 — The Fairest of Them All
After a beauty contestant suffers what appears to be an accidental death, Gillespie and Virgil discover otherwise and fight to uncover the perpetrators.
